items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Alfred Laine Interview, 1951-04-21
items.q: I picked them boys up playing with me when they were just small children.

ctx.x: I sure did, lots of them.
I see. Now, another thing, too. Do you remember Tom Brown and Harry Shields when they used to play in the old days?
Yes, I do remember. I picked them boys up playing with me when they were just small children.
